rv.q: The cast is terrific, the technical elements are beautifully integrated, and the emotions land exactly where they are meant to.
Cygnet, following its signature style, created an artistic, fine version of this musical that is well worth it. Not to be missed.
Cygnet has given Dear Evan Hansen the kind of production that makes it easy to understand why the musical became such a phenomenon.
It’s an emotional journey, to be sure, but well worth the time.
From my perspective, director Blake McCarty's dazzling, high-tech production succeeds admirably in delivering a very sympathetic Evan in the hands of talented actor Aiden Meyndert.
